title: Prism V4.2 Mini-Auditor Output Schema
description:
Validates the JSON output of prompts/mini-auditor-combined.md (Standard tier, Flow B Step 4).

Enum values (HC-15):
- priority: MUST be one of [high, medium, low]
- severity: MUST be one of [high, medium, low]

No free-form values outside that enum are permitted.

consensus.description: Claims agreed upon in the integrated version. 3-5 preferred; each item <= 30 CJK chars / 25 English words.

claim.description: The specific factual claim that needs external verification.

evidence_needed.description: What kind of evidence would confirm/refute (e.g. 'official documentation', 'latest published data').

priority.description: Priority for verification. HC-15: MUST be exactly one of [high, medium, low]. No other values allowed.

risk.description: The specific risk of adopting/using the proposal.

severity.description: Risk severity. HC-15: MUST be exactly one of [high, medium, low]. No other values allowed.
